local_total_capacity_bound.interpretation: Two local capacity conventions are reported. The row positive-contract convention is larger and should be used for payment safety; this is still finite-window evidence, not a global proof.

G1_candidate_statement.name: scale_stable_capacity_bound
G1_candidate_statement.claim_needed: For every recursive peeling chain reaching a dangerous R5 state, the active capacity L_j stays below a universal L_max before it enters the finite certified terminal window, or else the excess capacity forces positive defect and exits the dangerous class.
G1_candidate_statement.minimal_sufficient_form: 0 <= L_j <= Lmax on all stable positive-mass steps; jumps are charged separately and backflow losses are summable.
G1_candidate_statement.warning: Use at least L_cap=0.48 after the multi-window Lyapunov audit; the 0.47 value only covered this single row-level payment window.

proof_obligations_remaining: G1a: define active capacity L_j intrinsically for arbitrary scale X, not by the finite window extractor.
G1b: prove shell monotonicity/nonnegative mass for stable steps after canonical relabelling.
G1c: prove either L_j <= Lmax or a capacity-energy defect D_j >= delta(L_j) that excludes the bad configuration.
G1d: prove the terminal finite-window certificate is reached by the recursion without changing the functional semantics.

G1_capacity_bound.name: G1_capacity_bound
G1_capacity_bound.statement: G1 prime form: along every recursive dangerous chain, either the normalized active capacity satisfies L_j <= L_cap, or the excess capacity forces a positive defect that exits the dangerous class.
G1_capacity_bound.current_local_evidence: docs/d4-r5-G1-capacity-audit.json and docs/d4-r5-G1-lyapunov-energy-audit.json; resource-curve local max L=0.4213905845641671; row positive-contract local max L=0.45976127079428586; multi-window row max L=0.4750671263244978; safe local L_cap=0.48
G1_capacity_bound.global_status: not proved globally; reduced to capacity-defect dichotomy plus scale-transfer invariance
remaining_obligations: Define L_j,D_j invariantly across arbitrary scales and shell relabellings.
Prove large normalized capacity implies positive defect in every frozen member cell.
Show failures project to the finite outward-certified terminal window family.

G2_stable_payment_telescope.name: G2_stable_payment_telescope
G2_stable_payment_telescope.current_status: proved algebraically once G1 and Delta L_j>=0 on stable positive-mass steps hold

G3_jump_absorption.name: G3_jump_absorption
G3_jump_absorption.statement: Each jump either reduces badness by kappa_j or lands in finite certified windows; sum jump errors is finite.

G4_backflow_summability.name: G4_backflow_summability
G4_backflow_summability.statement: Backflow projection loss eps_j is summable and below local outward-certificate margin.
G4_backflow_summability.current_local_evidence: backflow not triggered in current probe
